title: Medical Imaging Report

origin.url: Not published online: contributed by the patient
origin.publisher: Rebound Orthopedics & Neurosurgery (Northwest Surgical Specialists, P.C.), Vancouver, WA
origin.title: Faxed shoulder MRI report with fax cover sheet (March 2019)
origin.clearance_note: A real faxed radiology report, contributed by the patient it describes, who gave explicit permission for it to be published here on the condition that their name is not shown. It is not from the internet and has no source URL. The patient chose to have only their name removed; everything else is as faxed, including the clinic's staff roster, the referring and reading physicians, the medical record and accession numbers, and the clinical findings. The scan arrived with the patient's name and date of birth covered by black stamp annotations that left the scan beneath intact; those regions were burned into the page images so the originals are gone, not hidden. PDF metadata cleared.

redactions.method: Image pixels burned to blank under a solid black box, replacing removable stamp annotations that had left the scan intact beneath
redactions.verified: Raw embedded image pixels under every box read pure white (255) after burning; no annotations remain; PDF metadata empty

notes: Replaces the earlier medical-imaging-report folder (a 3-page New York State DOCCS sample report), at the operator's direction. The request supplied the schema (schema_mri_report.json, used unchanged) and named no feature page or fields. Page 2 features the study itself: what was scanned, when, what it was compared against and how it was imaged. The findings and impression, the most interesting text on the page, could not be featured: each spans several lines and grounds OFF, one range per line, none of which contains the whole value. Identifier fields (MRN, accession number) and physician names ground ok but were deliberately not featured: the study fields make the same point without them.
